description: C2's nomapweaponalert. The map WK Hail rains WK_HAIL_Q, a HAILSTORM with default damage 0 (5 against ARMMSTOR) and nomapweaponalert=1, over a grid of the player's solar collectors and four metal storages; `--map "WK Hail C"` rains WK_HAIL_L, the same hail without the key, as its control. The camera sits on the empty west half, because the engine's under-attack notification skips a unit on screen. With the key: no "Under Attack" (its next time, dword 0x50871C, stays put), no blink of a hit unit's minimap dot, no minimap dot for a hailstone, and every hit applied as stock (a storage's HP falls, +0xFA is set). Content: tools/datakeys_fixture.py into the instance's gamedir.
